done_when: Choosing narrow or split updates the plan's builder details and brings them into the task branch in one step; close starts no review round when nothing changed since the last review and the findings repeat, and goes straight to the owner's question; one close run publishes the pull request body at most once, and sync run inside a task worktree never changes the Forge pin; in Forge's repo and in client repos, new and upgraded
why: About 40% of review rounds are process waste: narrowing needs hand merges of the plan, rounds run with no change, and Forge's own records cost rounds and API calls
